context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 verified trailing responsiveness improvements: (1) Config has scan_interval_sec=60 and position_active_sleep_sec=15 in bot section, (2) _should_scan_entries_now() gates entry scanning by scan_interval_sec (60s) - prevents scanning on every fast position tick, (3) _get_cycle_sleep_sec() returns position_active_sleep_sec (15s) when LIVE mode and positions exist, (4) Signal-only mode always uses default cycle_sleep (60s) regardless of position count, (5) No regressions in exchange_closed protections (all iteration 36 tests pass). rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Trailing execution lag (e.g., PAXGUSDT) was caused by position management being tied to the same 60s cycle as entry scanning. When positions exist, trailing stop updates were delayed by up to 60s.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Decoupled entry scanning from position management: (1) Added scan_interval_sec (60s) to gate entry scanning, (2) Added position_active_sleep_sec (15s) for faster position management when LIVE with positions, (3) _get_cycle_sleep_sec() returns shorter sleep when positions active, (4) _should_scan_entries_now() ensures entry scanning still happens at 60s intervals.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 77 tests pass confirming: config values correct, scan interval gate works, cycle sleep is faster with positions in LIVE mode, signal-only mode unaffected, no regressions in exchange_closed protections.
